reviews.reason: 完整保留的本地论证先构造Laurent矩阵模型，以交错约化字最高次系数非零和行列式次数不相容证明PSL2作用忠实，再用等变同态及二矩阵共同中心化子把Δ上的核压成标量。这里需要针对该代数设计并连接两个表示机制，超出直接代入标准表示论结论；但主要工具仍是自由积约化字、显式矩阵和多项式次数控制，不据名称或篇幅升H3。
reviews.core_assessment: lem:faith1(834–911)中最高λ次数恰等于s的次数，因为s1 p s1=−s1、s1 p^-1 s1=s1，端点p幂可逆；若为标量，det强迫次数减半，矛盾。 prop:uhomoh(915–979)逐项验证像满足Δ中央关系，构造的是同态π，不假定其单射。 lem:comdiagf(983–1020)在ρ/σ生成元上核等变性；σ对gamma的像νI保持，因为μ是中心Laurent标量。 最终g在Δ为恒等则其共轭矩阵ξ与qA+q^-1 A^-1及A+A^-1同时交换；q²!=1可解得与A交换，同理B；共同中心化子为标量，再由Λ上忠实性推出g=1。 未把PBW/Diamond单歧义当成难度；本题不依赖PBW或π单射。

standard_prerequisites.name: PSL2(Z)=C3*C2 with reduced alternating-word normal form
standard_prerequisites.use: Representation construction and nontrivial reduced-word test.

standard_prerequisites.name: Center of Mat2(F[lambda,lambda^-1]) consists of scalar matrices
standard_prerequisites.use: Standard ring-theoretic fact; author statement and short proof marker retained at628–642.

standard_prerequisites.name: Basic polynomial degree, determinant and matrix multiplication

core_obligations: Construct the Laurent matrix realization and prove the proposed q-dependent images satisfy the central defining relations of Delta.
For every reduced modular-group word, prove its Laurent-matrix representative is noncentral using a nonvanishing top coefficient and incompatible determinant-imposed scalar degree.
Use equivariance and simultaneous centralizers of the specialized A/B matrices to pull faithfulness back to Delta without assuming the realization pi is injective.

proof_roadmap.step: Define order-three and order-two automorphisms using the alternative algebra presentation.
Define Acal/Bcal/Ccal and conjugating p/s, verify products and common centralizer.
Top lambda coefficient in every alternating word is a nonzero signed p-power/s1/p-power; centrality would force degree ell/2 while actual degree is ell.
Construct equivariant pi; a kernel element commutes with qAcal+q^-1Acal^-1 and scalar Acal+Acal^-1, hence with Acal and Bcal, forcing trivial conjugation and trivial group word.

approved_task_config.difficulty_reason: The counted result still requires an explicit noncommutative algebra-to-Laurent-matrix construction and transfer of faithfulness through a homomorphism which is not assumed injective. The essential local proof controls every alternating free-product word by its top polynomial coefficient and compares that degree with the determinant of a hypothetical scalar word, then identifies simultaneous centralizers to recover Delta faithfulness. All these author steps are retained as core, rather than assumed as prerequisites. H2 is proposed on this full chain; no H3 inference from the algebra name or article status. The separate PBW theorem with one Diamond-Lemma ambiguity was read but not promoted as another H2 task.

compared.difference: The public primary describes a vector-space basis of the centre for q not a root of unity; it does not count faithful PSL2(Z) action.

An algebra homomorphism into U_q(sl2) tensor a three-variable Laurent ring is injective; the present result is injectivity of the modular group action on the universal Askey-Wilson algebra. Distinct maps, statements and proof obligations.
Change of basis in a pencil of quadrics transforms an associated endomorphism by a fractional linear expression; no faithfulness claim on the Askey-Wilson algebra.
